$sources: Decisions D-019: the Nympheas oval is the first stage built and anchors the plan until the Rotunda joins; its east port mates the Salon's west port, beyond bay 5.

The arrival is in the anchor's frame, whose origin is the oval's centre on the finished floor: 3 m in from the oval's east apex (the inner face at x 11.000, salon.md section 3.1), on the long axis, facing west down the room to the pond.

matings.note: The oval passage: the Salon's bay 5 far wall meets the oval's passage block.
The Rotunda's west door to the Salon's Bay 1 end wall (outer face museum x -13.40): the joint's 2.20 m passage, a plain drum-section arch (rotunda.md section 2).
The Rotunda's north door onto Chenghuai's open porch on the drum face (rotunda.md section 2).
The Rotunda's south door to Albion's porch, its flat end wall tangent to the drum; the joint fills the wedges (rotunda.md section 2).
The Rotunda's east door to the Hall of Light's concave R 11.20 face, the way on (rotunda.md section 2).
The spiral stair's portal at the landing (0, -7.60, -6.00), facing north, served by the Rotunda's well; the Classical Hall reserves the prism (rotunda.md section 2).
